description: The 60 evaluation configurations of the RefRoute benchmark. Image and mask fields are identifiers under the canonical layout described in benchmark/BENCHMARK.md, not redistributable assets.

routing_policy.N=2: M_order[0] -> R_order[0]; remaining two masks -> R_order[1]

note: settings.steps and settings.guidance are the values used for every reported run, applied by experiments/run_all.sh. plan_file_defaults records the unused defaults carried in the plan file.
